title: Edge-Adaptive Hiera-Seg Model for Building-Integrated Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.21680v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Building integrated photovoltaic power forecasting is challenging because facade orientation, rooftop geometry, nearby buildings, vegetation, cloud movement, module temperature, inverter status and edge device reliability jointly affect power generation. This paper proposes an edge-adaptive HieraSeg model for short term BIPV power forecasting with multi-orientation visual-irradiance fusion. RGB facade images, optional thermal cues, irradiance measurements, module temperature, facade orientation, rooftop masks, shading labels, sky condition, historical power and edge device state are aligned into synchronous forecasting windows. HieraSeg extracts hierarchical regions from facade, rooftop, sky, shadow and background images, while the edge-adaptive module changes feature weights under missing frames, latency shifts and local shading changes. translated_title: 面向建筑一体化光伏功率预测的边缘自适应Hiera-Seg模型
translated_abstract: 建筑一体化光伏功率预测具有挑战性，因为立面朝向、屋顶几何形状、附近建筑物、植被、云层移动、组件温度、逆变器状态和边缘设备可靠性共同影响发电量。本文提出了一种边缘自适应HieraSeg模型，用于结合多朝向视觉-辐照度融合的短期BIPV功率预测。RGB立面图像、可选热成像线索、辐照度测量值、组件温度、立面朝向、屋顶掩膜、遮挡标签、天空状况、历史功率和边缘设备状态被对齐到同步预测窗口中。HieraSeg从立面、屋顶、天空、阴影和背景图像中提取分层区域，而边缘自适应模块在缺失帧、延迟变化和局部遮挡变化的情况下动态调整特征权重。分割分支识别被遮挡的组件区域，并分离立面、屋顶、天空和背景（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出边缘自适应HieraSeg模型，通过多朝向视觉-辐照度融合，并在缺失帧、延迟变化和局部遮挡条件下自适应调整特征权重，实现短期建筑一体化光伏功率预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an edge-adaptive HieraSeg model that fuses multi-orientation visual and irradiance data, adaptively adjusting feature weights under missing frames, latency shifts, and local shading changes for short-term building-integrated photovoltaic power forecasting.
